name: Year Tree
summary: Drag through the months and one swaying tree blossoms, fills out, turns gold and goes bare
about: A hand-grown tree stands on a hill while you scrub through the year. Blossoms open and drift away in spring, the crown turns deep green in summer with fireflies at dusk, leaves blush gold and red and tumble off in autumn, and snow settles on bare branches in winter. Good for a garden or nature site, a weather page or a seasonal sale banner.
how: Drag the slider (or use the arrow keys, a month at a time) to move through the year.
Sky, sun, hills, leaves, blossoms and snow all blend smoothly between the months.
Dragging fast through autumn makes the real leaves let go and tumble down, and a gust bends the branches.
Tap a season to glide there, or press Play the year to loop through all twelve months.
With reduced motion the branches stay still, there are no falling particles and season jumps are instant.
